Connections to the bus are made through the open-drain
line SDA and SCL input pin. The SDA and SCL
pins feature integrated spike suppression filters and Schmitt triggers to minimize the effects of input spikes and
bus noise. The TMP1075 supports the transmission protocol for fast mode up to
